method: Static interface analysis; audited small source fragments in a restricted probe; independent native adapters. Entire remote bundle is not imported or executed. Live-verified sources are labeled separately from offline adapter candidates included for phone-side testing.
scope: The full bundle was inventoried: 54 explicitly named metadata entries plus dynamically generated/config-dependent sources. Eight non-cloud public-content sources now have native CatPaw adapters: Qimiao, Duboku, Xingya, Ciyuancheng, Baidu Haokan short drama, Yiyingshi, Ikanbot and Weiguan. Qimiao and Duboku have live media evidence; the other five are included for device-side acceptance based on their documented public interfaces and local adapter fixtures where available.
